in_marathi.name: Meghrajni
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of clouds
in_marathi.long_meaning: Meghrajni हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Meghrajni is a Sanskrit name that means 'Goddess of clouds'. In Hindu mythology, Meghrajni is the goddess of clouds and the giver of monsoon rains. She is often depicted riding on an elephant or a chariot pulled by horses.
